hypothesis: Observed ancestry reference information carried by ancestry-time-aware whole-tree context can improve the frozen, selected genomic smoothing baseline. Genuine ordered ancestral correspondence must separately outperform geometry controls to justify that mechanism.
method: Successor reference-context-only residual over frozen H025 ordinary smoothing. Pure-reference source labels and observed ages only, identical information in all matched arms. No trainable standalone local-logit recalibration bypass. Older references remain proxies rather than observed350-generation census ancestors. Whole inferred marginal trees and qualified joins preserved.
novelty_assessment: Established reference-conditioned diffusion and residual correction are discovery tools, not sufficient novelty. Neither H025 nor the successor is presently claimed as a new kernel or superior biological method. Priority and specific ordered whole-tree contribution require literature comparison plus diagnostic ablations.
repeat_policy: New information route and correction head, not an unchanged H025 rerun. One optimizer seed101, matched TRAINtile budget and same original full-support metrics. No additional seeds or FP64 sweep. Stop unchanged development if genuine geometry remains indistinguishable or all arms worsen.

protocol.observed_reference_labels: pure96 only, never query/context ancestry truth
protocol.scoring_support: same retained original100bp centers and clipped physical bins as nativeARGMix
protocol.selection: earliest minimum equal-parent developmentVAL Present64 exact-span NLL
